author: sjm41
body:
Following on from https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/25804:

I think these EXP annotations to "GO:0050062  long-chain-fatty-acyl-CoA luciferin component reductase activity" need changing:

UniProtKB:Q09517 let-767 PMID:18390550 Caenorhabditis elegans WB
=> change to GO:0141040 very-long-chain 3-oxoacyl-CoA reductase activity?
(UniProt annotates this to EC:1.1.1.330 (= xref on GO:0141040) from the same paper)

UniProtKB:Q0WRB0 FAR5 PMID:20571114 Arabidopsis thaliana TAIR
UniProtKB:Q39152 FAR1 PMID:20571114 Arabidopsis thaliana TAIR
UniProtKB:Q9LXN3 FAR4 PMID:20571114 Arabidopsis thaliana TAIR
=> change to GO:0102965 alcohol-forming long-chain fatty acyl-CoA reductase activity?
(UniProt annotates these to EC:1.2.1.84 from the same paper)
title: Review annotations to 'GO:0050062 name: long-chain-fatty-acyl-CoA luciferin component reductase activity'

author: pgaudet
body:
Hi @sjm41 

Isn't the term label, 'long-chain-fatty-acyl-CoA **luciferin component** reductase activity', overly specific ??

author: sjm41
body:
Maybe, but see #25804 for full explanation.

Briefly:
The previous name for GO:0050062 was just "long-chain-fatty-acyl-CoA reductase activity" (matching the EC name), but the [EC:1.2.1.50](https://enzyme.expasy.org/EC/1.2.1.50) entry says the reaction is specific to the bacterial luciferase system.

And as noted here, the more generic name appeared to have led to incorrect GO annotations.
So we changed the name and added a comment and TC in #25804.

But I guess we could revert the name and rely on the comment and TC to keep things in check?

author: pgaudet
body: OK - but then the RHEA is not an exact match, it should be broad ?

author: sjm41
body:
I think the RHEA is an exact match - the GO def and the RHEA reaction are identical.

My understanding from the EC comment was that the reaction only occurs in the context of the luciferase system, but maybe that's an over-interpretation.

I'll re-open https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/25804, and remove the 'luciferin component' from the term name.

author: sjm41
source_title: More clearly define/name 'long-chain-fatty-acyl-CoA reductase activity' GO:0050062?
